title: Carly's dashboard: where Roster lives
question: Gym location moves to an Account page behind Carly's initial in all three. Pick where Roster goes, or steer.

options.label: Full roster inside the Today pass
options.lineage: Pass + List by Day, with the pass as the door to the roster
options.thesis: The Today pass is already today's slice of the roster, so its last line opens the rest. One tap, one box fewer.
options.viewport: Greeting · black Today pass (Gladys Done, Josh Starts 7:00 pm) ending in 'Full roster ›' · Fortnight hours row · chips · list.
options.risk: Carly has to learn that the pass is tappable; the chevron line carries that.

options.label: Roster on the Account page
options.lineage: Pass + List by Day, with all setup behind the avatar
options.thesis: The dashboard is only today and what needs Carly. Roster sits with Gym location behind her initial.
options.viewport: Greeting · black Today pass · Fortnight hours row · chips · list. Initial → Account: Roster, Gym location, Switch user.
options.risk: Roster becomes two taps and hidden; she changes shifts often, so she may hunt for it.

options.label: Roster stays its own row
options.lineage: Pass + List by Day as built, minus the Gym location row
options.thesis: Keep what Carly already knows: a Roster row above Fortnight hours.
options.viewport: Greeting · black Today pass · Roster row · Fortnight hours row · chips · list.
options.risk: Two stacked boxes push the list lower on a phone; the first request starts near the fold.
